notes: «- المعنى -» and the dash-gloss about «ابن أبي بكر» and «أخو القاسم بن محمد» are editor glosses, left out
«كنا عند عائشة» places the hearing at her house (rule 6), but «فقالت سمعت رسول الله» is her own saying: she is the last link
«قال» before «كنا» is the teller Abdullah b. Muhammad, already the previous link
